title: Current calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the current using I = q/t, yielding 0.016 A.

title: Resistance calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the resistance using R = U/I, yielding 500 Ω.

title: Electron density formula
description: Important: The student must apply the relation I = n e S v to solve for the number density n.

title: Electron density calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute n = I/(e S v), yielding 10^27 m^{-3}.

title: Unit consistency
description: Important: The student must use consistent SI units (C, s, A, m, m/s) throughout all calculations.

title: Scientific notation handling
description: Optional: The student properly handles powers of ten and scientific notation in the final answer for n.

title: Incorrect current for resistance
description: Pitfall: Using the given charge (0.16 C) directly as current in Ohm's law, instead of I = q/t.

title: Formula misapplication for n
description: Pitfall: Rearranging I = n e S v incorrectly, e.g., n = I * e S v, or confusing v with voltage.
